name: roll_damage
description: Roll weapon or spell damage with automatic active-effect modifiers. Loads the attacker's active effects and appends any damage bonus dice (Hex adds +1d6 necrotic, Hunter's Mark adds +1d6, etc.) to the base expression. Call after a successful attack roll (from roll_attack) before applying damage with apply_damage.

attacker_type.description: Whether the attacker is a character or NPC.

attacker.description: Slug or UUID of the attacker.

target_type.description: Entity type of the target (for context).

target.description: Slug or UUID of the target.

base_expression.description: Base damage dice expression, e.g. '1d8+3' for a longsword, '2d6+4' for a greatsword. Do NOT include effect bonus dice — those are appended automatically.

damage_type.description: Damage type of the base attack (e.g. 'slashing', 'piercing', 'fire', 'radiant'). Shown in the output and passed to apply_damage.

mode.description: system: compact total only. transparent: full breakdown with per-die results. user: prompts player to roll base dice and enter totals, then auto-rolls any effect bonus dice.

description.description: Optional label for this roll, e.g. 'Longsword damage' or 'Eldritch Blast'.
